_about: Sound roles for UI-mockup / product-explainer reels. For each role earshot renders every candidate design, ranks them against `want` by ear, and the winner is rendered as `takes` variations (role_1..n). Designs come from earshot's catalogue (`earshot sounds --search <words>`). Ved's rule: real-action and product-UI designs; no long chimes or bells as effects.

pop.want: a soft round low pop as a card appears on screen

tap.want: a soft low tap as an app icon lands

click.want: a crisp clean interface click as a button is pressed

tick.want: a tiny airy digital tick for a list item appearing

type_run.want: a quick run of soft digital typing ticks as text types on

swish.want: a soft short swish of air as one screen blurs into the next

accent.want: a tiny soft tick marking a scene change under a voice-over

sub.want: a deep sub bass boom under a reveal, felt more than heard

whoosh_in.want: a fast crisp whoosh as a card zooms toward the camera

iris.want: a big airy whoosh transition into a new scene

riser.want: a short digital riser building into a cut

hit.want: a low punchy hit as a big number or title lands

success.want: a small satisfying confirmation click when a check mark appears

notify.want: a soft phone notification as a message banner drops in

glint.want: a short bright glint as a light sweeps across a card

zip.want: a quick tonal zip as a counter rolls up

shutter.want: a quick camera shutter click as recording starts
